findings.body:
**Map a missing `.cq/review/<branch>` folder to the existing guidance message.**

If a branch has never run `review.run`, the folder does not exist. In that case `readdir(folder)` rejects with ENOENT before the `!files[0]` guard runs. The owned catch at Line 3318 then surfaces the raw "ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir …" text instead of 'no findings record; run review.run or pass --record'. `admitHistory` at Line 1394 already treats ENOENT as empty, so the same handling fits here.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-                    const files = (await readdir(folder))
+                    const files = (
+                      await readdir(folder).catch((error: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
+                        if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return [] as string[];
+                        throw error;
+                      })
+                    )
                       .filter((name) => /^\d+\.json$/.test(name))
```
</details>
